WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, 
         AVG(CAST(scans.gbsize AS FLOAT) / CAST(scans.spanmin AS FLOAT)) as avg_rate, 
         COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scans 
  JOIN sites s ON scans.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as overall_rate FROM status_rates
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, s.avg_rate, s.scan_count, o.overall_rate, s.avg_rate - o.overall_rate as excess
  FROM status_rates s, overall_avg o
  WHERE s.avg_rate > o.overall_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rate) as avg_rate_filtered,
  AVG(scan_count) as avg_scan_count_filtered,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_statuses
